provenance: deterministic model simulation, instantaneous policies; not observed human gameplay

policies.greedy: accept every fitting candidate, depart when queue exhausted
policies.planning: reserve for valuable visible next two-floor requests, prefer value density, accept valuable heavy >=600point, reject impossible deadlines

interpretation: Always-fit and always-light are not always optimal. The simple planning heuristic is not always optimal either: scenario1 valuable long-haul copier reverses the greedy comparison. No universal strategy claimed.
